lfr.zhTW: {rt8}妮姆瑞莎·喚波者{rt8}||世界難度容錯很高：跟著大部隊打，邊緣刷出來的魚人小怪看到就順手清掉。坦克面前的直線水流不要站在射線上。全團掉血的[深淵之雨]期間站好別亂跑，讓治療把血線奶滿。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Nimrissa the Wavecaller{rt8}||LFR is forgiving: follow the group and casually clear the murloc adds that spawn at the edges. Don't stand in the tank's line [Water Gust]. During raid-wide [Abyssal Rain] hold position so healers can top you off.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}妮姆瑞莎·喚波者{rt8}||分配遠程與帶減速的職業專門攔[魅惑氣泡]刷出的魚人，不讓它們走進中間。[冰寒之霜]點名後按提示移動，不要把寒冰球帶進人堆。[深淵之雨]前提前鋪盾，坦克始終把直線技能引向空地。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Nimrissa the Wavecaller{rt8}||Assign ranged plus a slows class to intercept the [Charmed Bubble] murlocs before they reach center. After [Frozen Frost] mark, move as prompted and don't bring the frost orb into the group. Pre-shield before [Abyssal Rain]; tanks keep line abilities pointed at open space.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}妮姆瑞莎·喚波者{rt8}||各技能約20秒一輪且會互相重疊，[魅惑氣泡]的小怪波與[深淵之雨]同時到來時要先保住團隊血線再清怪。[破潮者衝鋒]的路徑要提前空出來，被撞到還會連帶吃後續傷害。全程盯[無盡潮汐]計時，清怪拖太久會被狂暴追上。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Nimrissa the Wavecaller{rt8}||Abilities cycle ~20s and overlap; when [Charmed Bubble] adds and [Abyssal Rain] arrive together, stabilize health before clearing. Pre-clear the path of [Tidebreaker Charge]—getting hit chains into follow-up damage. Watch the [Endless Tide] timer; slow clearing gets caught by the enrage.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}妮姆瑞莎·喚波者{rt8}||神話把[水流疾風]換成更凶的[水流噴射]，坦克必須精準控制射線方向並按提示輪換承受。魚人小怪的數量與刷新更密，需要固定兩組人負責左右兩側且不佔用BOSS的輸出窗口。[冰寒之霜]與[深淵之雨]重疊的窗口要預排團減，狂暴前的DPS餘量很小。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Nimrissa the Wavecaller{rt8}||Mythic swaps [Water Gust] for the deadlier [Water Jet]; tanks must aim the beam precisely and rotate who takes it on cue. Murloc count and spawn rate rise—fix two teams on left/right that don't eat the boss DPS window. Pre-plan raid DR for the [Frozen Frost] + [Abyssal Rain] overlap; DPS margin before enrage is tiny.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}陵寢哨兵{rt8}||核心只有一條：兩隻哨兵永遠分開站，別把它們拉到一起，否則它們會有99%減傷。綠色那隻噴出的[劇毒水滴]要主動跑上去踩掉，全部踩完才不會爆炸。身上掛[螺旋毒素]後去找一個同樣中毒的人撞一下，疊到4層就會自動消失。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Crypt Sentinels{rt8}||One rule: keep the two sentinels apart—never let them touch or they gain 99% damage reduction. Run onto the [Venom Droplets] the green one spits and soak them all so they don't explode. With [Spiral Toxin], collide with another poisoned player to stack to 4 layers and clear it.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}陵寢哨兵{rt8}||兩坦分左右各帶一隻，中間空出至少40碼；DPS分成兩隊各打一隻，血量同步壓，別讓[強酸靜滯]白奶回來。全員分工踩[劇毒水滴]併集火[毒液凝塊]，治療盯死[凋零之血]的驅散。[螺旋毒素]事先編好兩人一組的碰撞對，撞到4層即可。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Crypt Sentinels{rt8}||Two tanks, one per side, at least 40 yards apart; split DPS into two teams and sync health so [Acid Stasis] doesn't undo your healing. Everyone soaks [Venom Droplets] and focus the [Venom Clot]; healer dispels [Withering Blood] on schedule. Pre-pair [Spiral Toxin] collision partners—four stacks clears it.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}陵寢哨兵{rt8}||英雄的[活體毒液]在噴出4秒後會飛回源頭，要提前讓開回程路線不要站在連線上。[螺旋毒素]必須精確4層，多撞或少撞都會留下持續傷害，配對表要固定到人。坦克按[強化猛擊]層數固定輪換，交換場地時不能脫手讓兩隻貼到一起。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Crypt Sentinels{rt8}||Heroic [Living Venom] flies back to its source 4s after spawning—clear the return line, don't stand on it. [Spiral Toxin] must hit exactly 4 stacks; over/under-colliding leaves a lingering DoT, so fix pairs to people. Tanks rotate on [Empowered Smash] stacks and never let the pair drift together during swaps.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}陵寢哨兵{rt8}||分離容差進一步收緊，兩隻衝到一起放大招時大團要分成兩隊並定期交換場地，交換過程中順手完成換坦。血量必須嚴格同步，否則[強酸靜滯]奶回來的血量會直接吃掉一整輪爆發。任何一次[螺旋毒素]錯撞都會帶著DOT進入下一輪，節奏一旦亂掉很難補回來。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Crypt Sentinels{rt8}||Separation tolerance tightens further; when they clash and unleash the big ability, split the raid into two groups and periodically swap sides, handling the tank swap during the move. Health must be strictly synced or [Acid Stasis] healing eats an entire burst window. Any mis-collision carries the DoT into the next cycle—once the rhythm breaks it's hard to recover.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}烏拉特克{rt8}||跟緊人堆，看到地上蔓延的毒液波就繞開，別去踩蛇卵孵出來的小怪堆。有人被薄膜包住時優先打開救人。BOSS露出心臟的階段是集中輸出的時候，把大招都交出來。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Ulatak{rt8}||Stay with the group, skirt the spreading venom waves and don't step on the eggs that hatch adds. Free anyone trapped in a membrane first. When the boss exposes its heart, that's the burn window—dump cooldowns.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}烏拉特克{rt8}||毒液波的走向由團隊控制，指揮安排推向哪一側以減少孵化出的[吞噬者之嗣]。[受縛者之怒]暴露[劇毒之心]時嗜血爆發一次打滿。最後階段場地會被拆掉，提前往安全地面集中，不要留在邊緣等著掉下去。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Ulatak{rt8}||The venom wave's path is team-controlled—push it where it hatches fewest [Devourer Spawn]. When [Bound Wrath] exposes the [Venomous Heart], Bloodlust and burn it down. In the final phase the floor is destroyed—group on safe ground early, don't linger at the edge.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}烏拉特克{rt8}||階段轉換之間幾乎沒有喘息，[墜落碎石]與環境傷害持續疊加，治療CD要精確卡在兩個放大窗口上。孵化控制要求更嚴，一次錯誤的波路線會同時刷出多隻[吞噬者之嗣]導致人手不夠。P3[幽靈盤繞]必須全團按時堆到衝擊區，散開就是滅團。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Ulatak{rt8}||Almost no breather between phases; [Falling Debris] and environmental damage stack, so healer CDs must land precisely on the two amplify windows. Hatch control is stricter—one wrong wave path spawns multiple [Devourer Spawn] and you run out of hands. P3 [Phantom Coil] demands the whole raid stack on the impact zone on time; spreading is a wipe.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}烏拉特克{rt8}||史詩新增機制並把軟狂暴變成硬性檢查，[狂怒解放]之前必須結束戰鬥。毒液波路線、蛇卵孵化順序與塌陷區域要寫成完整跑法逐輪執行。近戰與遠程分區輪換，保證[劇毒之心]窗口內不掉輸出，任何一次站位失誤都會連鎖影響到下一階段。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Ulatak{rt8}||Mythic adds mechanics and turns the soft enrage into a hard check—finish before [Furious Liberation]. Venom-wave routes, egg-hatch order and collapse zones must be a written rotation executed each round. Melee/ranged rotate zones to keep DPS through the [Venomous Heart] window; any positioning mistake cascades into the next phase.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}盤卷祭壇{rt8}||前半段跟著人堆走：[斷頭台]要站進去一起分攤，地上的毒液和飛出來的斧子躲開。瑪拉卡斯出現後會有小怪盯著你追，邊跑邊打不要站着挨。身上出現[墓縛]時去撿地上的[靈魂碎片]就能解掉。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Coiled Shrine{rt8}||Follow the group in phase one: stand in [Guillotine] to share it, avoid the floor poison and flying axes. When Malakas appears, mobs chase you—kite and fight, don't stand still. With [Gravebind], grab a [Soul Shard] off the ground to clear it.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}盤卷祭壇{rt8}||分好[斷頭台]的分攤組，人數不足會把接的人直接打死。打斷[惡毒盤魂者]的[恐懼尖嘯]，[恐懼化身]鎖定誰就由誰負責風箏，其他人不要擋路。最終階段兩個目標血量聯動，提前算好爆發把它們同時打死。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Coiled Shrine{rt8}||Assign [Guillotine] soak groups; too few soakers dies instantly. Interrupt the [Vicious Coilbinder]'s [Terror Screech]; whoever [Fear Manifestation] locks kites it, others clear the way. Final phase links the two targets' health—pre-plan burst to kill both together.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}盤卷祭壇{rt8}||[凝聚毒液]會在場上不斷累積，分攤與風箏的路線必須同時避開毒液，位移技能要留著用。附身階段的[恐懼行軍]與[靈魂割裂]會和小怪波重疊，打斷表和轉火表要拆成兩組人分別負責。最終階段雙目標同時輸出壓力很大，團減與治療CD留到這裡再交。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Coiled Shrine{rt8}||[Condensed Venom] keeps accumulating—soak/kite paths must both avoid it; save mobility. The possessed phase's [Dread March] and [Soul Rending] overlap add waves; split interrupt and kill priorities between two teams. Dual-target final phase is heavy—save raid DR and healer CDs for it.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}盤卷祭壇{rt8}||容錯極低：斧線、[斷頭台]落點、[凝聚毒液]與[恐懼化身]的移動路線都要預先規劃成固定跑法。[幽暗炸彈]與[墓縛]需要按人輪換去撿碎片，漏掉一個人就會在下一波直接倒。最終階段必須做到兩個目標幾乎同時死亡，否則存活方的增傷會瞬間打穿治療。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Coiled Shrine{rt8}||Near-zero margin: axe lines, [Guillotine] landings, [Condensed Venom] and [Fear Manifestation] paths must be pre-scripted. [Gloom Bomb] and [Gravebind] shards rotate per person—miss one and they drop next wave. Final phase needs near-simultaneous kills or the survivor's damage amp blows through healing.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}萬毒邪祟者瓦什尼克{rt8}||看到從噴泉爬出來的大軟就集火，絕對不要讓它爬到房間中間的坑裡。身上出現[瘟疫泡沫]時跑到人堆外面，等毒液噴完再回來。被[爆炸感染]點名就跑遠，另外兩種感染留在原地讓治療奶就行。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Plague Sovereign Vashnik{rt8}||Focus any blob crawling from a fountain and never let it reach the central pit. With [Plague Foam], run out of the group and return after the spray. If marked by [Explosive Infection] run far; the other two infections just need healing in place.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}萬毒邪祟者瓦什尼克{rt8}||坦克通過帶位固定[痛飲]的噴泉組合，盡量避開難處理的搭配。分好近戰與遠程各攔一條軟怪路線，控制技能對暗影和烈焰軟有效，鮮血軟免控只能硬打。[燃燒劇毒]與其他大軟錯開時間擊殺，避免[腐蝕湧動]和[幽影噴射]疊在一起。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Plague Sovereign Vashnik{rt8}||Tanks position to fix the [Quaff] fountain pairings, avoiding the worst combos. Split melee/ranged to intercept each blob lane; CC works on shadow/fire blobs but the blood one is CC-immune and must be hard-focused. Stagger [Burning Venom] kills to avoid [Corrosive Surge] and [Shadow Spray] overlapping.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}萬毒邪祟者瓦什尼克{rt8}||英雄增加[惡行催化劑]：萬毒之穴上方凝出毒液寶珠，全團先吃一次高額毒素傷害，隨後飛散的[催化膽汁]必須有人接住，空放會改為全團掉血。噴泉排空更快，[灌注]層數疊上來後軟怪血量與噴射傷害翻倍，清怪節奏必須提速。[滴毒之牙]的物理易傷期間治療要盯死坦克並配合外部減傷。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Plague Sovereign Vashnik{rt8}||Heroic adds [Vile Catalyst]: a venom orb forms above the pit—raid takes one big poison hit, then the scattered [Catalytic Bile] must be caught or it becomes raid-wide damage. Fountains drain faster; once [Infusion] stacks, blob health and damage double, so clear faster. During [Venom Fang] physical vulnerability, healers babysit the tank with external DR.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}萬毒邪祟者瓦什尼克{rt8}||史詩額外加入原型毒液的配對與站位層，容錯接近於零，任何一隻軟進坑就是重開。三種[適應性感染]會重疊出現，需要預排驅散、吸收盾與外場爆炸位的輪換表。全程按[痛飲]節拍走，爆發窗口卡在[毒性蒸汽]層數還低的前幾輪。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Plague Sovereign Vashnik{rt8}||Mythic adds prototype-venom pairing and positioning layers; margin is near zero—any blob in the pit is a restart. The three [Adaptive Infections] overlap, requiring pre-planned dispel, absorb-shield and outer-explosion rotations. Follow the [Quaff] cadence and burst in the early rounds before [Toxic Vapor] stacks climb.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}雙子毒牙{rt8}||身上的[永恆毒液]層數是命門，快到上限時一定要站進伊斯拉茲的[貪婪盛宴]分攤範圍裡消層。地上的綠色黏液和飄著的毒球不要踩、不要碰。看到小蛇[維克蘇爾之嗣]刷出來立刻轉火打掉，它每發唾液都會給你加層數。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Twin Venomfangs{rt8}||Your [Eternal Venom] stacks are lethal—when near cap, stand in Israz's [Gluttonous Feast] soak range to drop them. Don't step on green slime or touch drifting venom orbs. Swap to the [Spawn of Vex'thul] the moment it spawns; each spit adds stacks.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}雙子毒牙{rt8}||兩坦分別貼住兩條蛇，[碎石擊]一定要有人在3碼內接住。安排固定的人去接[腐蝕洪流]噴出的液滴，避免讓全團一起吃層數。雙頭血量同步壓，最後同時擊殺，不要留出[怒湧]窗口。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Twin Venomfangs{rt8}||Two tanks each latch one snake; someone must stand within 3 yards to catch [Shard Strike]. Assign fixed players to catch [Corrosive Flow] droplets so the whole raid doesn't take stacks. Sync the two health bars and kill together—no [Surge] window.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}雙子毒牙{rt8}||英雄的[貪婪盛宴]會把吞下的毒液變成[血團凝塊]，[起泡混合物]讓它隨層數變大變厚，必須立刻集火，否則[鮮血噴湧]會持續疊加全團增傷。滿能量時維克蘇爾的[湧動]與伊斯拉茲的[洪流]同時到來，需要提前留好團減和治療大技能。[凝固血肉]的血池會壓縮場地，站位要預留撤退空間。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Twin Venomfangs{rt8}||Heroic [Gluttonous Feast] turns swallowed venom into [Blood Clot]; [Effervescent Mixture] grows it with stacks—focus it immediately or [Blood Surge] keeps stacking raid-wide damage. At full energy Vex'thul's [Surge] and Israz's [Flow] arrive together—pre-save raid DR and big heals. [Congealed Flesh] blood pools shrink the floor; leave retreat room.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}雙子毒牙{rt8}||層數管理精確到人：接液滴、進[貪婪盛宴]、吃[攪動深淵]都要按表輪換，任何一次多吃都可能頂到10層暴斃。[血團凝塊]要按正確順序餵給伊斯拉茲，處理不乾淨就會帶著疊滿的[鮮血噴湧]進下一輪。收尾必須讓兩條蛇同時倒下，誤差控制在幾秒之內。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Twin Venomfangs{rt8}||Stack management is per-person: catching droplets, entering [Gluttonous Feast], eating [Churning Abyss] all rotate by roster—one extra stack can hit 10 and kill. Feed [Blood Clots] to Israz in the right order or they carry full [Blood Surge] into the next round. The finish must drop both snakes within seconds of each other.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}盤魂者內克扎莉{rt8}||只要記住三件事：中間那口井裡的黑水別站、小怪別放進井裡、被[盤魂]拉著走時原地等打斷或驅散。BOSS掉到一半會撤退，此時集火場上的[賈瓦埃的回響]把她拉回來。最後階段全團掉血變快，交個人減傷跟緊治療。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Soulbinder Ny'kazza{rt8}||Just three things: never stand in the black water of the central well, don't let adds reach the well, and when [Soulcoil] pulls you, wait for an interrupt or dispel. At half health the boss retreats—focus the [Echo of Jawae] adds to pull her back. In the final phase raid damage ramps up; use personal DR and stay near the healer.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}盤魂者內克扎莉{rt8}||安排兩組人輪流用減速與控制攔停[無眠的阿曼尼]，一隻都不要放進[盤魂之井]。[盤魂點燃]的4秒引導前鋪好盾，引導中同時躲[苦痛回響]的擊退小圈；[精華撕裂]結束後順手清掉[潛藏的教徒]。50%集火[賈瓦埃的回響]，[解除盤卷]是軟狂暴，嗜血留到這個階段一次打完。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Soulbinder Ny'kazza{rt8}||Assign two groups to rotate slows and CC to halt the [Sleepless Amani]—never let one reach the [Coil Well]. Pre-shield before the 4s [Soulbind Ignition] channel and dodge the [Agonizing Echo] knockback circles during it; after [Essence Rending] clear the [Hiding Cultists]. At 50% burn the [Echo of Jawae]; [Uncoiling] is a soft enrage—save Bloodlust for that phase.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}盤魂者內克扎莉{rt8}||英雄額外附加[儀式灼燒]，每層讓[盤魂儀式]傷害再提高15%且持續1分鐘，所以一次漏怪就會讓後面雪崩，控怪鏈必須零失誤。[盤魂點燃]要固定用團減加額外治療CD頂過去，DOT與易傷層數高時不要硬吃。盡量在易傷層數堆起來之前推進階段，避免帶著滿層進[解除盤卷]。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Soulbinder Ny'kazza{rt8}||Heroic adds [Ritual Scald]: each stack raises [Coil Ritual] damage by 15% for 1 min, so one missed add snowballs—the CC chain must be flawless. Cover [Soulbind Ignition] with a fixed raid DR plus an extra healer CD; don't hard-soak with high DoT/vulnerability stacks. Push phases before vulnerability stacks build; avoid entering [Uncoiling] at full stacks.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}盤魂者內克扎莉{rt8}||階段轉換新增[緊攫深淵]：[溺亡的回響]週期性把全團往井口拉並持續掉血，必須盡快擊殺；進井輸出的人離開時會帶[靈魂疲憊]（受井與[不朽纏繞]傷害+300%），要排輪換名單進出。[祈求]階段必須斷滿所有[潛藏的教徒]的施法，被打斷的施法者會讓打斷人沉默3秒，因此踢斷表要按人排死。整場幾乎零容錯，一次進井或漏斷基本等於重開。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Soulbinder Ny'kazza{rt8}||Phase transitions add [Grashing Abyss]: [Drowned Echoes] periodically drag the raid toward the well while draining health—kill them fast. Players who go in to DPS leave with [Soul Fatigue] (+300% damage from the well and [Undying Coil])—rotate a strict in/out roster. During [Supplication] every [Hiding Cultist] cast must be interrupted; the interrupted caster silences the interrupter for 3s, so assign kick order per person. Near-zero margin—one well entry or missed interrupt is a wipe.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}斯索拉克{rt8}||站在BOSS側後方，不要吃正面的錐形攻擊。被綠色毒液點名就跑到人少的地方，爆炸後留下的毒球不要去碰。颳大風把你吹起來時，去撞一個同樣被吹起的隊友就能落地。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Ssothalak{rt8}||Stand behind the boss and avoid the frontal cones. When marked by green venom, run to an empty spot; don't touch the poison orb it leaves. When the gale lifts you, collide with another lifted ally to land.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}斯索拉克{rt8}||[毀傷]要安排足夠人數一起分攤，人太少會直接把接的人打死。[狂怒側風]結束會把你吹飛並掛[湍流陣風]，提前找好互撞的搭檔解除。[掘地固守]的25秒是唯一的+30%易傷窗口，把嗜血和爆發全壓在這裡。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Ssothalak{rt8}||[Devastate] needs enough players soaking together or it one-shots the soaker. [Furious Crosswind] ends by launching you with [Turbulent Gust]—pre-find a collision partner to clear it. The 25s [Burrow Stance] is the only +30% damage window; dump Bloodlust and all cooldowns there.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}斯索拉克{rt8}||[粘稠囊腫]會在場上越鋪越多，放置位置要提前規劃出通行路線，[呼嘯旋渦]期間沒有落腳點就等於送人頭。坦克[劫掠]疊層後承傷成倍上漲，需要外部減傷配合固定的換坦點。[侵蝕毒液]與[風暴]的中毒減速疊在一起時移動會很吃力，留好位移技能。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Ssothalak{rt8}||[Viscous Cysts] pile up—plan placement to keep paths open; during [Shrieking Vortex] with no footing you're a free kill. After [Plunder] stacks the tank takes multiplied damage, needing external DR and fixed swap points. [Corroding Venom] + [Storm] slow stacks make movement painful—save mobility.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}斯索拉克{rt8}||史詩加入[毒蛇之怒]：被標記玩家8碼內必須湊夠14人才會觸發[大開殺戒]，人數不夠BOSS就會攢滿怒氣進[怒不可遏]直接滅團。[大開殺戒]留下的[劇毒]在被移除時會爆炸並留下[腐蝕殘渣]（站內+30%承傷），驅散時機與站位必須統一指揮。全程在「湊人分攤」與「分散躲風」之間來回切換，節奏錯一次就補不回來。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Ssothalak{rt8}||Mythic adds [Serpent's Wrath]: the marked player needs 14 people within 8 yards to trigger [Kill Frenzy]; short on numbers and the boss fills rage and enters [Uncontrollable] for a wipe. [Venom] left by [Kill Frenzy] explodes on removal and leaves [Corrosive Residue] (+30% intake); dispel timing and positioning need one caller. Constant switching between 'stack to soak' and 'spread to dodge wind'—one missed beat can't be recovered.

lfr.zhTW: {rt8}迷失的探險者{rt8}||三隻龜龜站得越散越好，擠在一起它們就有99%減傷根本打不動。地上會掉箱子、彈跳蘑菇和震盪炸彈，看到就走開，被炸飛後注意落點。撿到[噁心的魚]就往被控制的龜身上砸，能把它救回來。
lfr.enUS: {rt8}Lost Explorers{rt8}||Spread the three turtles as far apart as possible—together they gain 99% DR and become unkillable. Crates, bounce mushrooms and shock bombs drop on the ground; move away and mind your landing after knockbacks. Grab a [Nasty Fish] and throw it at a mind-controlled turtle to free it.

normal.zhTW: {rt8}迷失的探險者{rt8}||提前分三組分別去接[巨力重擊]的三個落點做分攤，沒人接會全團重傷。打斷[書卷賢者伊庫]的[寒冰烈焰]，[霜火彈幕]分散站防止兩球合併。三隻血量同步壓，最後留[書卷賢者伊庫]，不要提前打死任何一隻。
normal.enUS: {rt8}Lost Explorers{rt8}||Pre-assign three groups to the three [Colossal Smash] landing spots for soaking; unsoaked hits wipe the raid. Interrupt [Scroll Sage Iku]'s [Frostfire]; spread for [Frostfire Barrage] so the orbs don't merge. Sync the three health bars and leave [Scroll Sage Iku] for last—don't kill any early.

heroic.zhTW: {rt8}迷失的探險者{rt8}||[真菌爆炸]與[衝擊波]一碰就是百萬級傷害，[爆炸驚喜]擊飛後要控制好落點不要落進蘑菇裡。[莫爾扎希]滿能量會狂暴，[噁心的魚]要卡在[黑暗低語]剛上手時就砸掉，並優先砸沒被砸過的目標。擊殺順序失誤觸發[無情加劇]基本等於滅團，斬殺階段要統一指揮。
heroic.enUS: {rt8}Lost Explorers{rt8}||[Fungal Blast] + [Shockwave] is million-tier damage; after [Explosive Surprise] knockback control your landing away from mushrooms. [Morzahi] enrages at full energy—hit the mind-controlled turtle with a [Nasty Fish] the moment [Dark Whisper] lands, prioritizing un-fished targets. A wrong kill order triggers [Relentless Escalation] (near-wipe); unify the execute phase.

mythic.zhTW: {rt8}迷失的探險者{rt8}||小怪血量與計時全面收緊，分攤、打斷、砸魚三條鏈必須同時不掉線。三隻血量差要壓到極小，做到近乎同時進入斬殺，不留任何[無情加劇]窗口。近戰堆要同時兼顧[粉碎鐵鍬]的擊退與[邪眼]2碼掃射，站位需隨雕像輪換即時調整。
mythic.enUS: {rt8}Lost Explorers{rt8}||Add health and timers tighten across the board; the soak/interrupt/fish chains must all stay live. Keep the three health bars within a hair so they hit execute near-simultaneously, leaving no [Relentless Escalation] window. Melee must handle both [Crushing Shovel] knockback and [Evil Eye]'s 2-yard sweep, adjusting positioning as statues rotate.
